content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a graduation degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% marks . The prescribed educational progression is SSLC/SSC, HSC and graduation under the regular stream (10+2+3). Applicants must have at least two years of experience in banks or Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) as of the eligibility cut-off date, 30 September 2026. Only candidates domiciled in the following states or Union Territory are eligible: Tamil Nadu Puducherry Maharashtra Goa The Bank will give preference to candidates proficient in the local language. Candidates must also be willing to serve anywhere in India if transferred by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 28 years as of 30 September 2026 . Candidates must have been born on or after 1 October 1998 , subject to the prescribed relaxation. Candidates claiming SC/ST age relaxation must provide a valid certificate issued by the competent authority when required.

content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: South Indian Bank has specified a total annual Cost to Company (CTC) of Rs. 5.14 lakh for Junior Officer (Operations). The CTC includes NPS contribution, insurance premium and variable pay based on performance. Salary Clarification: The annual CTC is not the same as take-home salary. The notification does not provide a fixed monthly in-hand salary. Other benefits applicable to the Bank's regular employees, including regular-employee staff loans and perquisites, are not applicable to this contractual appointment.

content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Job Location 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment is being conducted for selected locations in Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Maharashtra and Goa. Candidates can apply for one location from the notified options. Transfer Condition: Although candidates apply for a selected location, the Bank reserves the right to transfer appointed employees anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Contract Period and Career Progression
content_sections.text: The Junior Officer (Operations) appointment is initially on a three-year contract , renewable at the sole discretion of the Bank based on performance evaluation. After completing the initial contract or any extension, high-performing employees may be considered for regular employment as Assistant Manager (Scale I) , subject to prevailing Bank norms. This is discretionary and is not a guaranteed promotion or conversion to permanent employment. The notification also states that the mandatory minimum service agreement applicable to regularly recruited staff does not apply to this contractual position.

content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Junior Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will involve Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview . The Bank may modify the selection process depending on the number of applications received. Shortlisting of eligible applicants Group Discussion and/or Personal Interview Verification of original documents and eligibility Medical fitness and background verification, including credit history, CFR and police clearance checks Final appointment subject to Bank requirements Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for the recruitment process. All selection-related communications will be sent through official channels, including the applicant's registered email address.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for South Indian Bank Junior Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at recruit.southindianbank.com/RDC/ . Read the Junior Officer (Operations) recruitment notification and verify the eligibility requirements. Open the online application for the Junior Officer (Operations) position. Enter the required personal, contact, educational qualification and work experience details. Select the preferred notified location as permitted by the application form. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and resume. Review the application carefully before submission. Submit the application online by 27 October 2026 . Save the system-generated User ID or Application Reference ID. Check the registered email for application details, login credentials and the application PDF. Log in to verify that the application status shows successful submission. Important: The Bank does not permit modification of submitted applications. Multiple registrations for the same role will result in disqualification. Candidates do not need to send a physical copy of the application to the Bank.

content_sections.heading: Photograph, Signature and Resume Upload Requirements
content_sections.text: Photographs with caps, hats or dark glasses will not be accepted. Applicants should retain two copies of the same photograph for use during the recruitment process.

faq.answer: The post notified is Junior Officer (Operations).

faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 27.10.2026.

faq.answer: The appointment is on contract initially for a period of 3 years, which is renewable at the sole discretion of the Bank based on performance evaluation.
